basic_details.job_title: Digital India Corporation Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Head, Database Administrator Posts
basic_details.short_information: Digital India Corporation has announced 2 temporary vacancies on a contract basis, comprising 1 post of Database Administrator (DBA) and 1 post of Head - CB & Onboarding. Qualifications vary by post, requiring a relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree as specified in the official notification under advertisement number DIC/MY Bharat/13/2026/10. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications on or before 27 October 2026. content_sections.heading: Digital India Corporation Database Administrator (DBA) at a Glance

rows.details: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, Government of India
Consolidated remuneration commensurate with qualifications and experience within approved project norms
Not stated in the notice (maximum age shall be as on the last date of receipt of applications)
Noida or New Delhi (transferable to project locations)

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Minimum 6+ years of experience in database administration and data management, preferably in large-scale applications. Experience managing databases on Cloud and working with cloud-native tools.
rows.desirable_preferred_skills: Proficiency in SQL, NoSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, and Redshift. Experience with RDS, database tuning, scaling, and optimization strategies. Familiarity with data encryption, Keycloak/JWT-based security, and secure access policies. Working knowledge of Docker, Jenkins, Git, and automated deployment workflows.

rows.essential_qualification: Master’s degree in Education, Social Work, Public Administration, Development Studies, Human Resource Management, or a related field. Minimum 10+ years of experience in capacity building, training, or onboarding leadership roles.
rows.desirable_preferred_skills: Strong experience in training design, e-learning, onboarding strategies, and stakeholder engagement. Excellent understanding of adult learning principles, digital literacy frameworks, and training content creation. Proficiency in handling LMS platforms, interactive tools, and blended learning models.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Digital India Corporation Database Administrator (DBA)
content_sections.text: Visit the official online application portal at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ . Fill out the online application form with the required details for the desired post. Submit the application online on or before 27 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting shall be carried out through an objective evaluation matrix based on educational qualification, relevant experience, domain expertise, certifications, publications, and other criteria as approved by the Competent Authority. Only shortlisted candidates shall be invited for selection interviews. Selection shall be made by a duly constituted Selection Committee as approved by the Competent Authority of DIC.

rows.event: Last Date of Receipt of Applications

faq.question: Q1. Are these positions permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The positions are purely temporary in nature on a contract or consolidated basis for the MY Bharat project of Digital India Corporation, and appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment.

faq.question: Q2. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisting is carried out through an objective evaluation matrix based on educational qualification, relevant experience, domain expertise, certifications, publications, and other criteria as approved by the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q3. Can candidates currently employed under government entities apply?
faq.answer: Candidates already in regular or contractual employment under Central or State Government, Public Sector Undertakings, or Autonomous Bodies are expected to apply through proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate from the employer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit online applications?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of applications is 27 October 2026.
